name: atlas
description: ATLAS: four dials for how a coding assistant talks to you, and seven subagents that keep the noisy work out of your conversation.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus seven subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation.

plugins.name: atlas-solo
plugins.description: The same four dials and the same rules, without the seven subagents. Fewer fixed tokens per session.

plugins.name: atlas-min
plugins.description: Compression only: two levels, one command, nothing else. For anyone who wants shorter answers and nothing more.

plugins.name: atlas-code
plugins.description: Everything in atlas, plus a coding section: tests, verification, planning, shipping and more, each read only when used, and an optional guard hook. review, fix and secure were run headless on real projects of several languages; the rest was tried in sessions but not measured.

plugins.name: atlas-mem
plugins.description: Everything in atlas, plus a memory that notices when it has become false: notes written by hand, linked to code, flagged as suspect when that code or what it depends on changes. Ships tree-sitter grammars for thirteen languages (22 MB).
